[!cgo] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo

logos build -o $WORK/paired$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/paired$GOEXE
stdout '^ok standard-directive-fastcall$'
go tool objdump -s 'main\._Cfunc_paired(\.abi0)?$' $WORK/paired$GOEXE
stdout 'CALL runtime\.logosCgocallFast'
! stdout 'CALL runtime\.cgocall'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/standarddirectivefastcall

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
#cgo noescape paired
#cgo nocallback paired
int paired(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() {
	if got := int(C.paired(40, 2)); got != 42 {
		panic("paired C call returned wrong value")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok standard-directive-fastcall")
}
